M-DOCTOR.NAME: Environment doctor
M-DOCTOR.purpose: Honest health report for a MyGRACE project and its DSH integration: project docs, config, environment tools, skills, MCP row and panel.

fn-buildDoctorReport.PURPOSE: Read-only report construction that never throws for unreadable inputs.

fn-doctorFindings.PURPOSE: Map check rows to ADR-3 findings (exit-code source of truth).

type-DoctorReport.PURPOSE: Typed check rows plus error/warning totals and effective config.

CrossLink.relation: installed skills and MCP row checks

contract.purpose: Honest health report for a MyGRACE project and its DSH integration: project docs, config, environment tools, skills, MCP row and panel.

param.name: report
param.description: Project, environment, integration and dev-tool checks.

error.description: Environment probe failures are reported as check rows, not exceptions.

notes.note-1: Probes are read-only (execFileSync for versions, readFileSync for config files).
notes.note-2: Project findings are derived from the same lint engine the gate uses, so doctor cannot disagree with lint.
notes.note-3: Exit code matches findings in both text and JSON modes.
